title: Low-norms cube hypercontractivity
statement:
Fix a dimension $n$ and real exponents $p, u$ with $1 < p \le u \le 2$, and set the
noise rate
\[
  \rho \;=\; \sqrt{\frac{p-1}{u-1}} \;\in\; (0,1].
\]
Then for every function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ on the Boolean hypercube, the noise
operator $T_\rho$ contracts $L^p$ into $L^u$:
\[
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{T_\rho f}^{\,u}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{1/u}
  \;\le\;
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{f}^{\,p}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{1/p},
\]
where the expectations are taken with respect to the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
replaced:
For $1 < p \le u \le 2$, any $n$, $f : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n \to \bbr$ and
$\rho = \sqrt{(p-1)/(u-1)}$,
\[
  \bigl(\E[\abs{T_\rho f}^u]\bigr)^{1/u} \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}.
\]
